--========================================================--
-- GOJO NPC KILLER
-- R6 + R15 | MOBILE + PC
--
-- Blue            = 3s cooldown
-- Red             = 5s cooldown + red explosion
-- Hollow Purple   = 10s cooldown + BIG
-- Limitless Fly   = 5s cooldown / INFINITE FLIGHT
-- Teleport        = 3s cooldown
--
-- LIMITLESS FLY:
-- • Infinite duration
-- • Control with WASD / mobile joystick
-- • Camera controls direction
-- • Unequip tool to stop flying
-- NPC ONLY
--========================================================--

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

--========================================================--
-- CHARACTER
--========================================================--

local Character
local Humanoid
local Root

local function SetupCharacter(char)

	Character = char
	Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	Root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

end

SetupCharacter(
	Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
)

--========================================================--
-- SETTINGS
--========================================================--

local BLUE_DAMAGE = 35
local RED_DAMAGE = 50
local PURPLE_DAMAGE = 500

local NPC_PUSH = 35
local NPC_FREEZE_TIME = 2.5

local BLUE_COOLDOWN = 3
local RED_COOLDOWN = 5
local PURPLE_COOLDOWN = 10
local FLY_COOLDOWN = 5
local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 3

local FLY_SPEED = 75

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE = 35

local BLUE_SPEED = 50
local RED_SPEED = 135
local PURPLE_SPEED = 180

local BLUE_SIZE = 1.5
local RED_SIZE = 1.8
local PURPLE_SIZE = 5

--========================================================--
-- SOUNDS
--========================================================--

local SOUND = {
	BlueCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	BlueFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	RedCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	RedFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	PurpleCharge = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	PurpleFire = "rbxassetid://12222216",

	Impact = "rbxassetid://12222152",

	Teleport = "rbxassetid://5568266006",

	FlyStart = "rbxassetid://911882310",
	FlyEnd = "rbxassetid://12222152",
}

--========================================================--
-- COOLDOWNS
--========================================================--

local Cooldown = {
	Blue = false,
	Red = false,
	Purple = false,
	Fly = false,
	Teleport = false
}

local function TryCooldown(name, time)

	if Cooldown[name] then
		return false
	end

	Cooldown[name] = true

	task.delay(time, function()
		Cooldown[name] = false
	end)

	return true
end

--========================================================--
-- SOUND
--========================================================--

local function PlaySound(id, volume, speed)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = volume or 1
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1

	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = 5

	sound.Parent = Root

	sound:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(sound, 10)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC CHECK
--========================================================--

local function GetNPC(part)

	if not part then
		return nil
	end

	local model =
		part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

	if not model then
		return nil
	end

	if model == Character then
		return nil
	end

	-- NEVER target players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
		return nil
	end

	local humanoid =
		model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then
		return nil
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	return model
end

--========================================================--
-- RED EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function RedExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "RedExplosion"
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		20,
		20
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		255,
		0,
		0
	)

	light.Brightness = 15
	light.Range = 30
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.4,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(14, 14, 14),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.Impact,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.5
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- PURPLE EXPLOSION
--========================================================--

local function PurpleExplosion(position)

	local part = Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name = "HollowPurpleExplosion"

	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		180,
		0,
		255
	)

	part.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
	part.Transparency = 0.1

	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false

	part.Position = position
	part.Parent = workspace

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
		190,
		50,
		255
	)

	light.Brightness = 30
	light.Range = 50
	light.Parent = part

	local tween = TweenService:Create(
		part,
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.7,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		),
		{
			Size = Vector3.new(30, 30, 30),
			Transparency = 1
		}
	)

	tween:Play()

	Debris:AddItem(
		part,
		0.8
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- NPC HIT
--========================================================--

local function DamageNPC(
	npc,
	damage,
	direction,
	ability
)

	local humanoid =
		npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	local npcRoot =
		npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not humanoid then
		return
	end

	if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- NEVER damage players
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(npc) then
		return
	end

	-- DAMAGE
	humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)

	-- RED EFFECT
	if ability == "Red" and npcRoot then
		RedExplosion(npcRoot.Position)
	end

	-- PURPLE EFFECT
	if ability == "Purple" and npcRoot then
		PurpleExplosion(npcRoot.Position)
	end

	-- PUSH
	if npcRoot and direction then

		local push =
			Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

		push.MaxForce =
			Vector3.new(
				100000,
				100000,
				100000
			)

		push.Velocity =
			direction.Unit *
			NPC_PUSH
			+
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				8,
				0
			)

		push.Parent = npcRoot

		Debris:AddItem(
			push,
			0.15
		)

	end

	-- FREEZE
	local oldWalk =
		humanoid.WalkSpeed

	local oldJump =
		humanoid.JumpPower

	local oldRotate =
		humanoid.AutoRotate

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	task.delay(
		NPC_FREEZE_TIME,
		function()

			if humanoid
				and humanoid.Parent
				and humanoid.Health > 0
			then

				humanoid.WalkSpeed =
					oldWalk

				humanoid.JumpPower =
					oldJump

				humanoid.AutoRotate =
					oldRotate

			end

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE PROJECTILE
--========================================================--

local function CreateOrb(
	color,
	size
)

	local orb =
		Instance.new("Part")

	orb.Name = "GojoProjectile"

	orb.Shape =
		Enum.PartType.Ball

	orb.Material =
		Enum.Material.Neon

	orb.Color =
		color

	orb.Size =
		Vector3.new(
			size,
			size,
			size
		)

	orb.CanCollide = false
	orb.CanTouch = true
	orb.CanQuery = false

	orb.CastShadow = false

	orb.Parent = workspace

	local light =
		Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color =
		color

	light.Brightness =
		size * 7

	light.Range =
		size * 8

	light.Parent =
		orb

	return orb
end

--========================================================--
-- SHOOT
--========================================================--

local function Shoot(
	color,
	size,
	speed,
	lifetime,
	damage,
	fireSound,
	ability
)

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	local camera =
		workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local direction =
		camera.CFrame.LookVector

	local orb =
		CreateOrb(
			color,
			size
		)

	orb.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			Root.Position
			+
			direction * 4
			+
			Vector3.new(
				0,
				1,
				0
			)
		)

	local velocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	velocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

	velocity.Velocity =
		direction * speed

	velocity.Parent =
		orb

	PlaySound(
		fireSound,
		1.5,
		1
	)

	local hit = false
	local connection

	connection =
		orb.Touched:Connect(
			function(part)

				if hit then
					return
				end

				local npc =
					GetNPC(part)

				if npc then

					hit = true

					DamageNPC(
						npc,
						damage,
						direction,
						ability
					)

					if connection then
						connection:Disconnect()
					end

					orb:Destroy()

				end

			end
		)

	Debris:AddItem(
		orb,
		lifetime
	)

	task.delay(
		lifetime,
		function()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- BLUE
--========================================================--

local function UseBlue()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Blue",
		BLUE_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.BlueCharge,
		1.2,
		1.15
	)

	task.wait(0.15)

	Shoot(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			0,
			170,
			255
		),

		BLUE_SIZE,

		BLUE_SPEED,

		3,

		BLUE_DAMAGE,

		SOUND.BlueFire,

		"Blue"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- RED
--========================================================--

local function UseRed()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Red",
		RED_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.RedCharge,
		1.3,
		0.85
	)

	task.wait(0.15)

	Shoot(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			255,
			40,
			40
		),

		RED_SIZE,

		RED_SPEED,

		3,

		RED_DAMAGE,

		SOUND.RedFire,

		"Red"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- HOLLOW PURPLE
--========================================================--

local function UsePurple()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Purple",
		PURPLE_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.PurpleCharge,
		1.5,
		0.7
	)

	local charge =
		Instance.new("Part")

	charge.Shape =
		Enum.PartType.Ball

	charge.Material =
		Enum.Material.Neon

	charge.Color =
		Color3.fromRGB(
			170,
			0,
			255
		)

	charge.Size =
		Vector3.new(
			2,
			2,
			2
		)

	charge.Anchored = true
	charge.CanCollide = false
	charge.CanTouch = false

	charge.CFrame =
		Root.CFrame *
		CFrame.new(
			0,
			1,
			-5
		)

	charge.Parent =
		workspace

	local light =
		Instance.new("PointLight")

	light.Color =
		Color3.fromRGB(
			190,
			50,
			255
		)

	light.Brightness = 25
	light.Range = 45

	light.Parent =
		charge

	local tween =
		TweenService:Create(
			charge,
			TweenInfo.new(
				0.7,
				Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
				Enum.EasingDirection.Out
			),
			{
				Size =
					Vector3.new(
						PURPLE_SIZE,
						PURPLE_SIZE,
						PURPLE_SIZE
					)
			}
		)

	tween:Play()

	task.wait(0.7)

	if charge then
		charge:Destroy()
	end

	Shoot(
		Color3.fromRGB(
			170,
			0,
			255
		),

		PURPLE_SIZE,

		PURPLE_SPEED,

		4,

		PURPLE_DAMAGE,

		SOUND.PurpleFire,

		"Purple"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- LIMITLESS FLY
--========================================================--

local Flying = false
local FlyConnection
local FlyVelocity
local FlyTool

local function StopFly()

	if not Flying then
		return
	end

	Flying = false

	if FlyConnection then
		FlyConnection:Disconnect()
		FlyConnection = nil
	end

	if FlyVelocity then
		FlyVelocity:Destroy()
		FlyVelocity = nil
	end

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyEnd,
		1.2,
		1.2
	)

end

local function StartFly()

	if Flying then
		return
	end

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Fly",
		FLY_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	if not Root or not Humanoid then
		return
	end

	Flying = true

	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.FlyStart,
		1.5,
		0.8
	)

	FlyVelocity =
		Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

	FlyVelocity.MaxForce =
		Vector3.new(
			math.huge,
			math.huge,
			math.huge
		)

	FlyVelocity.Velocity =
		Vector3.zero

	FlyVelocity.Parent =
		Root

	FlyConnection =
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(
			function()

				if not Flying then
					return
				end

				if not Root
					or not Root.Parent
					or not Humanoid
					or Humanoid.Health <= 0
				then

					StopFly()
					return

				end

				local camera =
					workspace.CurrentCamera

				if not camera then
					return
				end

				-- Get normal player movement
				local moveDirection =
					Humanoid.MoveDirection

				-- Camera direction
				local cameraLook =
					camera.CFrame.LookVector

				local cameraRight =
					camera.CFrame.RightVector

				-- Convert normal movement into
				-- camera-relative 3D flight movement.
				local forwardAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraLook.X,
							0,
							cameraLook.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local rightAmount =
					moveDirection:Dot(
						Vector3.new(
							cameraRight.X,
							0,
							cameraRight.Z
						).Unit
					)

				local direction =
					Vector3.zero

				-- Forward/backward follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraLook *
					forwardAmount

				-- Left/right follows camera
				direction +=
					cameraRight *
					rightAmount

				-- Preserve vertical camera direction
				-- when moving forward/backward.
				if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then

					direction =
						direction.Unit

					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						direction *
						FLY_SPEED

					-- Face the direction of flight
					Root.CFrame =
						CFrame.lookAt(
							Root.Position,
							Root.Position +
							direction
						)

				else

					-- No movement = hover in place
					FlyVelocity.Velocity =
						Vector3.zero

				end

			end
		)

end

--========================================================--
-- TELEPORT
--========================================================--

local function UseTeleport()

	if not TryCooldown(
		"Teleport",
		TELEPORT_COOLDOWN
	) then
		return
	end

	if not Root then
		return
	end

	PlaySound(
		SOUND.Teleport,
		1.5,
		1
	)

	local camera =
		workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local direction =
		camera.CFrame.LookVector

	local params =
		RaycastParams.new()

	params.FilterType =
		Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		Character
	}

	local result =
		workspace:Raycast(
			Root.Position,
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE,
			params
		)

	local destination

	if result then

		destination =
			result.Position -
			direction * 3

	else

		destination =
			Root.Position +
			direction *
			TELEPORT_DISTANCE

	end

	Root.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			destination,
			destination + direction
		)

end

--========================================================--
-- TOOL CREATION
--========================================================--

local ToolData = {
	{
		Name = "Blue",
		Tooltip = "Gojo Blue | Cooldown 3s",
		Action = UseBlue
	},

	{
		Name = "Red",
		Tooltip = "Gojo Red | Cooldown 3s",
		Action = UseRed
	},

	{
		Name = "Hollow Purple",
		Tooltip = "Hollow Purple | Cooldown 10s",
		Action = UsePurple
	},

	{
		Name = "Limitless Fly",
		Tooltip = "Infinite Flight | Unequip to stop",
		Action = StartFly
	},

	{
		Name = "Teleport",
		Tooltip = "Teleport | Cooldown 3s",
		Action = UseTeleport
	}
}

--========================================================--
-- REMOVE ONLY OUR TOOLS
--========================================================--

local function RemoveGojoTools()

	local backpack =
		Player:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Backpack"
		)

	local function Clean(container)

		if not container then
			return
		end

		for _, object in
			ipairs(container:GetChildren())
		do

			if object:IsA("Tool") then

				for _, data in
					ipairs(ToolData)
				do

					if object.Name ==
						data.Name
					then

						object:Destroy()
						break

					end

				end

			end

		end

	end

	Clean(backpack)
	Clean(Character)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE ONE TOOL
--========================================================--

local function CreateTool(data)

	local backpack =
		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack",
			10
		)

	if not backpack then
		warn("GOJO: Backpack was not found!")
		return
	end

	-- Don't create duplicate
	if backpack:FindFirstChild(data.Name) then
		return
	end

	if Character and
		Character:FindFirstChild(data.Name)
	then
		return
	end

	local tool =
		Instance.new("Tool")

	tool.Name =
		data.Name

	tool.ToolTip =
		data.Tooltip

	tool.RequiresHandle =
		false

	tool.CanBeDropped =
		false

	tool.Enabled =
		true

	tool.Parent =
		backpack

	-- Special handling for Limitless Fly
	if data.Name == "Limitless Fly" then

		FlyTool = tool

		tool.Unequipped:Connect(
			function()

				StopFly()

			end
		)

	end

	tool.Activated:Connect(
		function()

			if not tool.Enabled then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(
				data.Action
			)

		end
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- CREATE ALL TOOLS
--========================================================--

local CreatingTools = false

local function CreateAllTools()

	if CreatingTools then
		return
	end

	CreatingTools = true

	local backpack =
		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack",
			10
		)

	if not backpack then

		warn(
			"GOJO: Could not find Backpack!"
		)

		CreatingTools = false
		return

	end

	-- Small delay prevents respawn race conditions
	task.wait(0.2)

	RemoveGojoTools()

	task.wait(0.1)

	for _, data in
		ipairs(ToolData)
	do

		CreateTool(data)

	end

	CreatingTools = false

	print(
		"GOJO: All 5 tools created!"
	)

end

--========================================================--
-- RESPAWN
--========================================================--

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(
	function(newCharacter)

		StopFly()

		FlyTool = nil

		SetupCharacter(
			newCharacter
		)

		task.wait(1)

		CreateAllTools()

	end
)

--========================================================--
-- INITIAL CREATION
--========================================================--

task.spawn(
	function()

		Player:WaitForChild(
			"Backpack"
		)

		task.wait(0.5)

		CreateAllTools()

	end
)

	"🌀 GOJO SCRIPT LOADED - 5 ABILITIES"

        end)
        return ok
    end
    
    local function loadVerifiedKey()
        if not fileSystemSupported then 
            return nil 
        end
        
        local ok, content = pcall(function()
            return readfile("verified_key.txt")
        end)
        
        if not ok or not content then 
            return nil 
        end
        return content
    end

        return ok
    end

    function UI.new(options)
        local self = setmetatable({}, UI)
        
        self.options = options or {}
        self.title = self.options.title or "Key Verification System"
        self.subtitle = self.options.subtitle or "Powered by Junkie Development"
        self.description = self.options.description or "Please complete the key verification to continue"
        
        self.lastRequestTime = 0
        self.requestCooldown = 15
        self.maxAttempts = 5
        self.currentAttempts = 0
        
        self.player = Players.LocalPlayer
        self.gui = nil
        self.hwid = game:GetService("RbxAnalyticsService"):GetClientId()
        
        self._connections = {}
        
        return self
    end
    
    UI.createUI = function(self)
        local UIFactory = loadUIFactory()
        
        if UIFactory then
            local uiBuilder = UIFactory(Colors, Players, TweenService, UserInputService, Lighting)
            if uiBuilder then
                uiBuilder(self)
            else
                error("UI builder initialization failed")
                return
            end
        else
            error("Failed to load UI factory")
            return
        end
if self.elements and self.elements.getLinkButton then
            table.insert(self._connections, self.elements.getLinkButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                self:handleGetLink()
            end))
        end
        
        if self.elements and self.elements.verifyButton then
            table.insert(self._connections, self.elements.verifyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                self:handleVerifyKey()
            end))
        end
        
        if self.elements and self.elements.keyInput then
            table.insert(self._connections, self.elements.keyInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
                if enterPressed then
                    self:handleVerifyKey()
                end
            end))
        end
        
        return self.gui
    end
    
    function UI:close()
        getgenv().UI_CLOSED = true
        for _, conn in ipairs(self._connections or {}) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end

-- NPC SCANNER
local NPCContainer = nil
local function getNPCContainer()
    if NPCContainer and NPCContainer.Parent then return NPCContainer end
    local hl = WS:FindFirstChild("Highlight")
    if hl then
        local en = hl:FindFirstChild("Enemy")
        if en then
            local hh = en:FindFirstChild("HighlightHolder")
            if hh then NPCContainer = hh; return hh end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function resolveChar(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end
    if inst:IsA("Highlight") then
        local ad = inst.Adornee
        if not ad then return nil end
        if ad:IsA("Model") then return ad end
        if ad:IsA("BasePart") then return ad:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA("Model") then
        if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return inst end
        return nil
    end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        return inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    return nil
end
local function scanNPCs()
    local list = {}
    local container = getNPCContainer()
    if not container then return list end
    local seen = {}
    local function tryAdd(char)
        if not char or seen[char] then return end
        seen[char] = true
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char.PrimaryPart
        if hum and head and root then
            table.insert(list, {
                Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                IsNPC=true, Label="NPC",
            })
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(d)) end
    for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do tryAdd(resolveChar(c)) end
    return list
end
local function scanPlayers()
    local list = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
            local char = plr.Character
            if char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and head and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                    table.insert(list, {
                        Character=char, Humanoid=hum, Head=head, Root=root,
                        Player=plr, IsNPC=false, Label=plr.Name, Team=plr.Team,
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end
local function scanAll()
    local list = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanNPCs()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    for _, t in ipairs(scanPlayers()) do table.insert(list, t) end
    return list
end

-- WALL CHECK
local function hasLineOfSight(fromPos, toPos, target)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local ignore = {}
    if LP.Character then table.insert(ignore, LP.Character) end
    if target and target.Character then table.insert(ignore, target.Character) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    local result = WS:Raycast(fromPos, toPos - fromPos, params)
    return result == nil
end

local function updateESP()

    if not Cam then return end
    if not Config.ESP.Enabled then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then
        for _, d in pairs(espDrawings) do hideESP(d) end
        return
    end
    local seen = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if (t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.NPCs)
        or (not t.IsNPC and Config.ESP.Players) then
            seen[t.Character] = true
            local d = getESP(t.Character)
            local dist = (t.Root.Position - lPos).Magnitude
            if dist <= Config.ESP.MaxDist then
                local top = t.Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
                local bot = t.Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                local ts, on1 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(top)
                local bs, on2 = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bot)
                if on1 and on2 and ts.Z > 0 and bs.Z > 0 then
                    local h = math.abs(bs.Y - ts.Y)
                    local w = math.max(h * 0.55, 12)
                    local x = ts.X - w * 0.5
                    local y = ts.Y
                    local col
                    if t.IsNPC then
                        col = Config.ESP.NPCColor
                    elseif t.Player and LP.Team and t.Team
                    and t.Team == LP.Team then
                        col = Config.ESP.TeamColor
                    else
                        col = Config.ESP.EnemyColor
                    end
                    d.hl.Adornee = t.Character
                    d.hl.FillColor = col
                    d.hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    d.hl.Enabled = true
                    d.box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box
                    d.box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                    d.box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                    d.stroke.Color = col
                    d.name.Visible = Config.ESP.Name
                    d.name.Text = t.IsNPC and "NPC" or t.Label
                    d.name.TextColor3 = col
                    d.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y - 18)
                    d.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 14)
                    d.name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    d.dist.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance
                    d.dist.Text = string.format("[%dm]", math.floor(dist))
                    d.dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ts.X - 100, y + h + 2)
                    d.dist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 12)
                    d.dist.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    if Config.ESP.Health and t.Humanoid then
                        local hp = math.clamp(
                            t.Humanoid.Health / math.max(t.Humanoid.MaxHealth, 1),
                            0, 1)
                        d.hpBg.Visible = true
                        d.hpBg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y)
                        d.hpBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
                        d.hpFill.Visible = true
                        d.hpFill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 6, y + h * (1 - hp))
                        d.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h * hp)
                        d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            math.floor(255*(1-hp)), math.floor(255*hp), 0)
                    else
                        d.hpBg.Visible = false
                        d.hpFill.Visible = false
                    end
                else hideESP(d) end
            else hideESP(d) end
        end
    end
    for char, d in pairs(espDrawings) do
        if not seen[char] or not char.Parent then
            hideESP(d)
            if not char.Parent then
                for _, part in pairs(d) do
                    if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
                        pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                espDrawings[char] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- AIMBOT
local function aimCameraAt(target, part, smoothness)
    if not target or not part then return false end
    local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    local goal = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, smoothness)
    return true
end

local function findBestTarget()
    if not Cam then Cam = WS.CurrentCamera end
    local center = viewportCenter()
    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
    local lPos = localPos()
    if not lPos then return nil end
    local camPos = Cam.CFrame.Position
    for _, t in ipairs(scanAll()) do
        if t.IsNPC or not (LP.Team and t.Team and t.Team == LP.Team) then
            local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and t.Head or t.Root
            local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if on and sp.Z > 0 then
                local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                if d <= Config.Aimbot.FOV and d < bestD then
                    -- Wall check: cast a ray from the camera to the target part
                    local pass = true
                    if Config.Aimbot.WallCheck then
                        pass = hasLineOfSight(camPos, part.Position, t)
                    end
                    if pass then
                        bestD = d; best = t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function updateAimbot()
    if not Config.Aimbot.Enabled then return end
    if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then return end
    if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    local target = findBestTarget()
    if not target then return end
    local part = Config.Aimbot.TargetPart == "Head" and target.Head or target.Root
    aimCameraAt(target, part, Config.Aimbot.Smoothness)
end

local FlightBV = nil
local function flightStart()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    hum.PlatformStand = true
    if not FlightBV or FlightBV.Parent ~= hrp then
        if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy() end
        FlightBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        FlightBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
        FlightBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        FlightBV.P = 1000
        FlightBV.Parent = hrp
    end
end
local function flightStop()
    if FlightBV then FlightBV:Destroy(); FlightBV = nil end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    end
end

local function updateMisc()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum then return end

    -- WalkSpeed
    if Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Enabled then
        hum.WalkSpeed = Config.Misc.WalkSpeed.Value
    end

    -- JumpPower
    if Config.Misc.JumpPower.Enabled then
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = Config.Misc.JumpPower.Value
    end

    -- NoClip
    if Config.Misc.NoClip then
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                p.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    -- Flight
    if Config.Misc.Flight.Enabled then
        if not FlightBV or not hrp then
            flightStart()
        end
        if FlightBV and hrp then
            local cam = WS.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                local move = Vector3.zero
                local speed = Config.Misc.Flight.Speed
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move = move - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if move.Magnitude > 0 then move = move.Unit * speed end
                FlightBV.Velocity = move
            end
        end
    else
        if FlightBV then flightStop() end
    end
end

            local rng = bg.AbsoluteSize.X

            local nv = math.clamp(
                sV + (input.Position.X - sX)/rng*(props.Max-props.Min),
                props.Min, props.Max)
            curV = nv
            local ratio = (nv - props.Min)/(props.Max - props.Min)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio,0,1,0)
            handle.Position = UDim2.new(ratio,-6,0.5,-6)
            vLbl.Text = string.format("%.0f", nv)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local GunESP = true
local PickupGun = false
local PlayerESP = false

local GunColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local PlayerColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "ESP_Gui"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Name = "Main"
Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 160)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -80)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Parent = Gui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- TITLE
--==================================================

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Hack Menu"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = Frame

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local Dragging = false
local DragStart
local StartPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

    if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

        Dragging = true
        DragStart = Input.Position
        StartPosition = Frame.Position

        Input.Changed:Connect(function()

            if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                Dragging = false
            end

        end)

    end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

    if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

        local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart

        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            StartPosition.X.Scale,
            StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
            StartPosition.Y.Scale,
            StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
        )

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- BUTTON CREATOR
--==================================================

local function CreateButton(Text, Position)

    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 35)
    Button.Position = Position
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 42)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Button.TextSize = 14
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Button.Text = Text
    Button.AutoButtonColor = true
    Button.Parent = Frame

    local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    ButtonCorner.Parent = Button

    return Button

end

--==================================================
-- BUTTONS
--==================================================

local GunButton = CreateButton(
    "Gun ESP: ON",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
)

local PickupButton = CreateButton(
    "Pickup Gun: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 77)
)

local PlayerButton = CreateButton(
    "Player ESP: OFF",
    UDim2.fromOffset(10, 119)
)

--==================================================
-- GUN DRAWING
--==================================================

local GunLine = Drawing.new("Line")

GunLine.Visible = false
GunLine.Color = GunColor
GunLine.Thickness = 2
GunLine.Transparency = 1

local GunText = Drawing.new("Text")

GunText.Visible = false
GunText.Text = "GunDrop"
GunText.Color = GunColor
GunText.Size = 16
GunText.Center = true
GunText.Outline = true
GunText.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

local GunHighlight
local LastGun

--==================================================
-- FIND GUN
--==================================================

local function GetGun()

    for _, Object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

        if Object.Name == "GunDrop" then
            return Object
        end

    end

    return nil

end

--==================================================
-- GUN HIGHLIGHT
--==================================================

local function SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight:Destroy()
        GunHighlight = nil
    end

    if Gun then

        GunHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

        GunHighlight.Name = "GunDropHighlight"
        GunHighlight.Adornee = Gun

        GunHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255)
        GunHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.5

        GunHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
        GunHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

        GunHighlight.DepthMode =
            Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

        GunHighlight.Enabled = GunESP
        GunHighlight.Parent = Gun

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP
--==================================================

local PlayerHighlights = {}
local PlayerTexts = {}

local function RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    if PlayerHighlights[Player] then
        PlayerHighlights[Player]:Destroy()
        PlayerHighlights[Player] = nil
    end

    if PlayerTexts[Player] then
        PlayerTexts[Player]:Remove()
        PlayerTexts[Player] = nil
    end

end

local function AddPlayerESP(Player)

    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

    local Character = Player.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    Highlight.Name = "PlayerESP"
    Highlight.Adornee = Character
    Highlight.FillColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.OutlineColor = PlayerColor
    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.65
    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    Highlight.DepthMode =
        Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

    Highlight.Parent = Character

    PlayerHighlights[Player] = Highlight

    local Text = Drawing.new("Text")

    Text.Text = Player.DisplayName
    Text.Color = PlayerColor
    Text.Size = 16
    Text.Center = true
    Text.Outline = true
    Text.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    Text.Visible = false

    PlayerTexts[Player] = Text

end

local function RefreshPlayerESP()

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then

            if PlayerESP then
                AddPlayerESP(Player)
            else
                RemovePlayerESP(Player)
            end

        end

    end

end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER JOIN
--==================================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)

    Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

        task.wait(0.5)

        if PlayerESP then
            AddPlayerESP(Player)
        end

    end)

end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)

    RemovePlayerESP(Player)

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

GunButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    GunESP = not GunESP

    GunButton.Text =
        "Gun ESP: " .. (GunESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    if not GunESP then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

    else

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = true
        end

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PICKUP GUN BUTTON
--==================================================

PickupButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PickupGun = not PickupGun

    PickupButton.Text =
        "Pickup Gun: " .. (PickupGun and "ON" or "OFF")

end)

--==================================================
-- CONTINUOUS GUN BRING TO TORSO
--==================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    if not PickupGun then
        return
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        return
    end

    -- R15 = UpperTorso
    -- R6  = Torso
    -- Fallback = HumanoidRootPart
    local Torso =
        Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not Torso then
        return
    end

    local Gun = GetGun()

    if not Gun then
        return
    end

    -- Move ONLY GunDrop to the torso
    local TargetCFrame = Torso.CFrame

    if Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Gun:PivotTo(TargetCFrame)

    elseif Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Gun.CFrame = TargetCFrame

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP BUTTON
--==================================================

PlayerButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    PlayerESP = not PlayerESP

    PlayerButton.Text =
        "Player ESP: " .. (PlayerESP and "ON" or "OFF")

    RefreshPlayerESP()

end)

--==================================================
-- GUN ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    local Gun = GetGun()

    -- Detect new GunDrop
    if Gun ~= LastGun then

        LastGun = Gun

        if Gun then

            SetupGunHighlight(Gun)

        elseif GunHighlight then

            GunHighlight:Destroy()
            GunHighlight = nil

        end

    end

    if not GunESP or not Gun then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        if GunHighlight then
            GunHighlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return

    end

    if GunHighlight then
        GunHighlight.Enabled = true
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local Position

    if Gun:IsA("BasePart") then

        Position = Gun.Position

    elseif Gun:IsA("Model") then

        Position = Gun:GetPivot().Position

    end

    if not Position then

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

        return

    end

    local ScreenPosition, OnScreen =
        Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Position)

    if OnScreen then

        local Mouse =
            UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

        GunLine.Visible = true
        GunText.Visible = true

        GunLine.From = Vector2.new(
            Mouse.X,
            Mouse.Y
        )

        GunLine.To = Vector2.new(
            ScreenPosition.X,
            ScreenPosition.Y
        )

        GunText.Position = Vector2.new(
            ScreenPosition.X,
            ScreenPosition.Y - 25
        )

    else

        GunLine.Visible = false
        GunText.Visible = false

    end

end)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP UPDATE
--==================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

    if not PlayerESP then
        return
    end

    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    for Player, Text in pairs(PlayerTexts) do

        local Character = Player.Character

        if Character then

            local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            if Head then

                local ScreenPosition, OnScreen =
                    Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                        Head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                    )

                if OnScreen then

                    Text.Position = Vector2.new(
                        ScreenPosition.X,
                        ScreenPosition.Y
                    )

                    Text.Visible = true

                else

                    Text.Visible = false

                end

            else

                Text.Visible = false

            end

        else

            Text.Visible = false

        end

    end

end)
